name: sc_ribbon_v1
guard: while sealed is true, germquant sc-straighten refuses any image whose stem is the image_stem of a test or reserved gonad unless --allow-sealed is given, and the truth loaders refuse test and reserved gonads unless final=True
frame_rule: zone polyline (Imaris stage um) to the pipeline frame: continuous index = (coord - ExtMin) / imaris_voxel - 0.5, pipeline um = index x nd2 voxel; ExtMin from the .ims header attributes, except the four RAD-51 test gonads, whose .ims is never opened: ExtMin xy = nd2 stage xy

synthetic.generator: germquant.sc_straighten.synth, distributions fixed in VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md section 2.3

filament_truth.content: 2 mid-pachytene male nuclei, 5 ribbons each, 3 single-vertex stubs (ignored)
